channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Report: Zac Robinson Headed to Detroit for Key Interview
item.description: Former Falcons OC Zac Robinson is traveling to Detroit to interview for the Lions’ offensive coordinator vacancy. He has a strong history with Jared Goff from their time with the Rams.

item.title: Pros and Cons of the Detroit Lions Hiring Zac Robinson as OC
item.description: Breaking down the pros and cons of the Detroit Lions hiring Falcons offensive coordinator Zac Robinson, including his fit with Jared Goff, Sean McVay roots, play-calling experience, and potential risks.

item.title: Report: John Harbaugh Nearing Agreement That Could Change the NFL Landscape
item.description: ESPN reports the New York Giants are finalizing a deal to hire longtime Ravens coach John Harbaugh. A Super Bowl champion and one of the NFL’s winningest coaches, Harbaugh could soon be leading Big Blue.

item.title: David Montgomery’s Cryptic Post Has Lions Fans Begging, Arguing, and Panic-Scrolling
item.description: Detroit Lions RB David Montgomery’s latest Instagram post, paired with a Paramore song, has fans split between “please stay,” “stop being a diva,” and “he gone” interpretations.

item.title: Detroit Lions Request to Interview Former HC Competition for Dan Campbell
item.description: The Detroit Lions have requested permission to interview Steelers OC Arthur Smith, who was a finalist for the Lions head coaching job in 2021 before Dan Campbell was hired.

item.title: Steelers Could Throw Major Wrench Into Detroit Lions’ OC Search
item.description: The Detroit Lions have requested permission to interview Steelers OC Arthur Smith, but Pittsburgh could block the move since it would be a lateral hire. Here’s what it means for Detroit’s coordinator search.

item.title: Pros and Cons of the Detroit Lions Hiring Arthur Smith as OC
item.description: Could Arthur Smith be the Detroit Lions’ next offensive coordinator? We break down the pros and cons of hiring the former Falcons head coach, his fit with Jared Goff, and why his scheme could unlock Sam LaPorta and Brock Wright.

item.title: Detroit Lions Land Blindside Protector in Dane Brugler’s Latest Mock Draft
item.description: Dane Brugler projects Utah LT Caleb Lomu to the Detroit Lions in his 2026 NFL Mock Draft as a potential successor to veteran Taylor Decker.

item.title: Detroit Lions Crystal Ball: Will Alex Anzalone Be a Lion in 2026?
item.description: Alex Anzalone is a team captain and defensive leader, but will the Detroit Lions be able to afford him in 2026? A crystal ball look at his future.

item.title: Detroit Lions Crystal Ball: Will Al-Quadin Muhammad Be a Lion in 2026?
item.description: Al-Quadin Muhammad is coming off an 11-sack breakout season in Detroit. Can the Lions afford to keep him in 2026, or will free agency pull him away?
